objective: Evaluate reliable quantum-centred learning at q16/PCA16 with coherent whole-model checkpoint selection; no quantum-advantage claim.

dataset.class_order: integer class IDs 0 through 12 in the source dataset order
dataset.model_input: first 16 columns of the stored scaled PCA matrices
dataset.additional_preprocessing: identity; no PCA or scaler refit

training_roles.partition: stratified, pairwise-disjoint, complete partition of all 2600 training examples
training_roles.indices_and_sha256: persist exact int64 dataset-position indices and canonical little-endian SHA-256 hashes
training_roles.validation_role: metrics and declared diagnostic observations only; never used for optimization, refitting, checkpoint selection, or tie breaking

readout.features: 16 P(qubit_i=0) marginals followed by 15 adjacent <Z_i Z_(i+1)> correlations
readout.classical_head: one-hidden-layer ReLU MLP, 16 hidden units, 13 softmax outputs
readout.parameter_vector: [96 ansatz parameters | complete MLP parameter vector]

optimization.strategy: joint quantum/classical parameter vector with warm-start and periodic readout refits
optimization.sampler_seed_policy: StatevectorSampler initialized with seed 42; record backend and actual shots for each measurement group

readout_fit.optimizer: existing deterministic NumPy MLP fitting procedure

best_checkpoint.evaluate: initial vector; every post-blocking pre-refit vector; each scheduled post-refit vector
best_checkpoint.objective: mean cross-entropy on the fixed 130-example checkpoint-reference subset at 512 shots
best_checkpoint.whole_state: compare and persist the complete [ansatz | MLP] vector
best_checkpoint.tie_breaking: no replacement unless the one-sided upper bound for candidate-minus-incumbent loss is below -0.0005
best_checkpoint.parameter_serialization: persist complete candidate vectors, component hashes, objective, phase, iteration, shots, reference-index hash, seed policy, uncertainty, and incumbent decision

finite_shot_comparison.estimator: paired fixed-example candidate-minus-incumbent mean loss difference
finite_shot_comparison.shot_variance: first-order delta method using the full covariance matrix of all 31 observables derived jointly from each example's bitstring counts
finite_shot_comparison.decision_bound: one-sided normal upper bound with Bonferroni alpha 0.05 across a maximum of 22 non-initial candidate comparisons
limitations: approximate finite-shot uncertainty conditional on these fixed examples and the local delta approximation
does not include population sampling, independent run seeds, backend drift, optimizer variability, or model misspecification
not a claim of statistical significance

per_block: SPSA gradient norms and two-probe empirical blockwise variance
parameter norms and relative movement from initialization
per_example_probabilities: quantum, classical, and complete parameter hashes
telemetry.calibration: multiclass Brier score and top-label ECE with 10 equal-width confidence bins

diagnostic_examples.validation: 5 stratified examples per class, selected with seed 42042 from validation only

measurement_observations.phases: initial post-warm-start and frozen selected checkpoint; checkpoint-reference counts already collected for every candidate are retained
fields: example ID, split, class, iteration, phase
standard errors, actual shots, backend, timestamp
sparse bitstring counts preserving joint-observable covariance
measurement_observations.format: atomic compressed NPZ plus JSON metadata sidecar; separate from probability artifacts

validation_reporting.final_checkpoint: evaluate all 650 validation examples at 512 shots

checkpoint_integrity_and_recovery.parameter_hash: SHA-256 of canonical contiguous little-endian float64 bytes
checkpoint_integrity_and_recovery.protocol_hash: SHA-256 of canonical JSON bytes for protocol.json
checkpoint_integrity_and_recovery.dataset_hashes: verify before any circuit execution and persist in attempt manifest
checkpoint_integrity_and_recovery.interruption: preserve the failed attempt and its last atomic checkpoint; do not silently resume optimizer metric/RNG state; a restart creates a new attempt from fixed initialization
checkpoint_integrity_and_recovery.errors: surface dataset, sampler, serialization, or integrity failures and stop the run
